content:
Maya (Growth): Quick ping — weekly KPI sync. noticed a weird drop in MQL->SQL after the launch post last Thursday. inbound lead routing looks noisy, can we huddle? Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/kpis :eyes:
Jared (Demand): Are we sure leads from webinar vs launch post are correctly attributed? cc @Lina
Lina (Analytics): Looking now. Top-line: sessions +18%, new leads +12%, but MQL->SQL fell from 6.2% -> 4.1%. Pulling raw export…
Lina (Analytics): ```
date,source,utm_campaign,leads,mql_rate
2026-03-15,organic,launch-blog,310,0.062
2026-03-18,paid,launch-post,420,0.041
2026-03-19,partners,webinar,140,0.038
```
Lina (Analytics): The partners/webinar cohort has a lower MQL rate, but some of those leads are being routed into the partner pipeline (so not counted as inbound MQL).
Sam (Content): We intentionally swapped the CTA on the launch post to the partners form (utm_source=partners) to test the co-promo. That could be the routing cause.
ops-bot: pipeline-rule-updated: 'partners -> partner-outreach' applied by @Alex Ops at 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z
Maya (Growth): @Alex Ops can you confirm that rule covers leads with utm_source=partners across all entry pages? Also can we temporarily override and route those to an inbound-test pool?
Jared (Demand): Proposal: route utm_campaign=launch_post -> inbound-test pool for 72h and run an A/B on formA vs formB. Measure MQL->SQL and demo conversion.
Lina (Analytics): Agree. I'll add dashboard widgets: 1) 'Launch UTM compare' with attribution toggle (last-click/linear) 2) cohort funnel for webinar registrants. ETA ~3hrs. Will add filters for routing tag.
Sam (Content): I can pause the scheduled webinar promo email for 24h so we can set up the split test CTAs.
Maya (Growth): Plan: A) Lina adds widgets & shares link; B) Ops override routing to inbound-test for 72h; C) Sam pauses promo; D) Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00 PT. If MQL->SQL doesn't improve >=5% by Monday, rollback routing. All good?
Jared (Demand): +1 :thumbsup:
Lina (Analytics): +1
ops-bot: override-scheduled: 'partners -> inbound-test' starting 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z for 72h (created by Alex Ops)
Maya (Growth): Lina, paste the widget link once ready and add two saved views (last-click and linear). Also include a small note about sample size needed.
Lina (Analytics): link: https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/widgets/launch-utm-compare — added saved views and notes. Export CSV attached to the Growth doc.
Sam (Content): Draft email flagged in Mailer: "pause for split". I'll update CTAs and mark ready once Ops confirms routing override.
Jared (Demand): Quick check — demo bookings from launch-post cohort are ~1.8% vs baseline 2.4%, so there is a quality dip beyond routing. We'll verify with the split.
Lina (Analytics): Adding an attribution breakdown and exporting a filtered CSV for Growth. Will post results in this thread when ready.
Maya (Growth): Final action owners: Lina (dash/widgets & export), Alex Ops (override), Sam (email pause & CTA drafts). I'll put the experiment on the Friday agenda and follow up. Thanks everyone — drop any anomalies here before Friday.
